source.locator: Eqs13/15/17 PDFpage9, Eq31 and Table5 PDFpage13
source.reading: Equations13/15/17 visually verified from PDFpage9; Table5 and Eq31 checked against primary PDF. Molar-mass form of31 uses M_i=N_A*m_i.
source.model: First-order Chapman-Enskog dilute-gas viscosity, with nonspherical cross-section A* from published Table5. This is not the full third-order polyatomic calculation.

review.source_replay_basis: Predeclared allowance for Table5 interaction viscosity rounded to0.001microPa s, A* to0.0001, and table1 intercepts to0.0001microPa s. Replay is not independent validation.
review.prediction_basis: Unchanged0.5percent screen from the Wilke review; not a propagated combined uncertainty. No fitting to mixture values.

settings.scope: Discrete source temperatures only. No A* interpolation/extrapolation to600K; no new dense-gas or brick claim.

source.reading: Table1 visually checked. Only zero-density viscosities selected, not initial-density slopes.
source.reference_kind: Quasi-isothermal zero-density intercepts obtained from Humberg2018 viscosity density series and Schafer2015 pureCO2; not raw measurements, not independent diffusion measurements.
source.intercept_uncertainty_note: These reported measurement uncertainties are not a separately propagated uncertainty for the zero-density intercepts.

review.screen_basis: Predeclared0.5percent comparison screen, rounded from the largest reported raw-measurement expanded uncertainty0.49percent; not combined uncertainty or a certification. Check pure-table inputs separately to isolate mixing-rule bias without fitting.

source.title: Ab initio intermolecular potential energy surface for the CO2-N2 system and related thermophysical properties
source.authors: J.-P. Crusius, R. Hellmann, J. C. Castro-Palacio, V. Vesovic
source.physical_scope: Dilute gas, rigid CO2 and N2 molecules, correlation to equimolar diffusion; composition dependence less than0.5percent is omitted. Not a porous diffusivity or dense-gas model.

source_uncertainty.kind: authors combined standard uncertainty, not a hard error bound

review.comparison_budget_basis: Declared2percent comparison screen for one-standard-uncertainty predictions and viscosity-derived effective diffusion. Not a formal combined uncertainty or direct experimental certification.
